author: Jacob Ortiz
method: Claim-level citation-support audit (N2). Each of the 304 kept sentences was read against the full OCR text of its cited passage(s) as stored in judgment_worksheet.jsonl. Labels: supported = claim present verbatim, as a faithful paraphrase, or as a matching table/number; partly = core claim present but with overstatement, fusion, or source-type misattribution; not = claim not supported by the cited page. No lexical/embedding overlap heuristic was used to decide support (N2). Verification ran against the frozen retrieval output; no DB, gate, config, or frozen source file was modified, and no passage was re-fetched from the Internet Archive (N1).

partly_sentences.basis: Measure is listed in the 2006-07 Saskatchewan budget performance plan, but its data column reads 'Under development'; 'was tracked as a performance measure' overstates a measure not yet producing data.

The Guide foreword attaches licensure-accounting to the Guide revision and 'modified its recommendations' to the usage of certain OTHER agents; the sentence fuses these into a single 'modified schedule recommendations to take into account licensure' claim the page does not state directly. (Schedule changes are separately real, captured in s2.)

The contaminant/parameter list is verbatim, but the cited source is an ecosystem-indicator selection sheet (Selection of indicators for Great Lakes basin ecosystem health), not a drinking-water guideline; 'Guidelines recommended measuring' misattributes the indicator's Measure field to guidelines.

Same source as s3 (ecosystem-indicator sheet). The Endpoint line is reproduced verbatim, but 'the endpoint for drinking water quality guidelines' misattributes that indicator's Endpoint field to guidelines. DIVERGENCE from first-pass 'supported', made for consistency with s3's same source-type caveat.

Cited page is a badly OCR-garbled two-column layout. 'Existing administrative data sets were used for surveillance' is present, but the sentence fuses it with the survey-collected 'information and physical measures on cardiovascular risk factors', implying administrative data collect physical measures (surveys do, not administrative data). Borderline 'not'; cannot be fully resolved without the page image, which N1 forbids re-fetching.

Verbatim through 'did not respond well to permanent nerve blocks or neurosurgery, but required a'; the cited passage ends there (printed page number follows). The completion 'a multidisciplinary approach' is not verifiable from the cited excerpt. Strict-partly / lenient-supported. DIVERGENCE from first-pass 'supported'.

divergences_from_first_pass.reason: Same ecosystem-indicator source-type misattribution as mq10 s3; conservative and consistent.
Completion 'a multidisciplinary approach' is beyond the cited excerpt, which cuts off at 'but required a'.

thin_or_inference_supported.note: Thin: the cited page is a program-reorganization list, but the exact phrase 'environmental hazards - water, air and soil components' is present.
'issued weekly' is inferred from the report's own label 'Report week 42 (Oct 18 to Oct 24, 2015)' -- a 7-day, week-numbered window. Well-grounded inference, not stated as 'weekly' in words.
OCR-heavy youth-guidelines list; the itemized guidelines nonetheless match the cited page.

scope_flags_not_support_failures.mq43: SCOPE (not a support failure): all 5 sentences are verbatim-supported by the cited Canadian Senate comparative report (health care systems in other countries), but a US Medicaid question was answered from a Canadian public-record document. This is the recorded gate false-answer (see audit_numbers false_answer_qids).
scope_flags_not_support_failures.mq44: SCOPE (not a support failure): sentences are on-topic-supported (except the s1 completion gap), but retrieval is topically loose across chronic-pain, psychiatric, medicare-history and Salk-vaccine sources. This is the recorded gate false-answer.

if_mq14s1_counted_not.note: strict unchanged (mq14 s1 is not 'supported' either way); lenient drops by one sentence.

if_both_divergences_reverted_to_supporte.note: author keeps mq10 s4 and mq44 s1 as supported.

robustness.reading: The strict rate lands between 0.980 (this audit) and 0.987 (first-pass); lenient between 0.997 and 1.000. Both bounds clear the 0.90 target (N2).
